review.reviewBody: I had such a great experience at this AI workshop. It was practical, inspiring, and genuinely fun. Jack, the host, did an amazing job of breaking down complex AI concepts in a way that was easy to understand…
I really enjoyed Jack’s AI seminar! He has a very forward-thinking perspective on AI and does a great job of explaining everything from understanding AI to actually using it in real life…

mainEntity.name: Who is the AI training for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teams of roughly 5 to 60 people in Dallas–Fort Worth where most people are not technical: operations, sales, admin, front office, planning, customer service. No coding. Everyone works on a task they already do.

mainEntity.name: What do people actually build during the training?

acceptedAnswer.text: One working workflow for a task they already do every week — a meeting brief from approved notes, a first-draft customer reply, a weekly report pulled from a spreadsheet, a research summary on an account. It runs by the end of the session, and each person leaves with a checklist for verifying the output before it goes out.

mainEntity.name: Is the training in English or Chinese?

acceptedAnswer.text: Either. The community series in Dallas in 2026 ran in Chinese; company sessions run in whichever language the room works in, and the materials come in both.

mainEntity.name: Which AI tools does the training use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whatever your company has already approved — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot. The method is the same across tools. The first thing covered is which data may go into a tool and which may not.

mainEntity.name: How much does AI training for a team cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is priced per engagement, by format and team size. Text TRAINING with your company name to (469) 425-4142 or email jack@aimanjack.com; after a 20-minute call you will have a recommended format and a quote.

mainEntity.name: How do you know whether the training worked?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two weeks after the session, we check whether the workflow was tested on real work, whether the result was accurate enough to use, where review took too long, and whether the task should continue, change, or stop. A small documented workflow that survived real use is the outcome — not a room that enjoyed the demo.

mainEntity.name: Can the training be run at our office?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Sessions are in person anywhere in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex — Dallas, Fort Worth, Plano, Richardson, Frisco, McKinney, Arlington, and everywhere between. Remote sessions are available on request.
